title: 实体身份、保守合并和人工编辑 (entity identity, conservative merge, human edit)

what_was_implemented.canonical_identity_tuple: Added identity_tuple() and attached an explicit (account, namespace, entity_type, schema_id, schema_version, schema_digest) anchor to every resolve_candidate_identity() result. Display names/titles/aliases and provisional model ids never participate, so the same fixed schema/source rebuild resolves to the same canonical id (TC-10.7, TC-16.12).
what_was_implemented.canonical_id_preserved_across_rebuilds: Canonical id remains a hash of the business key + applicability scope + schema/namespace tuple only, so duplicate model rebuilds collapse into one group instead of creating duplicate entities.
what_was_implemented.collision_aware_alias_ownership: Added alias_ownership(); a display name owned by more than one canonical id is reported in alias_collisions and left unowned in alias_ownership rather than silently merged. Alias ownership is still not verified (alias_ownership_verified=false).
what_was_implemented.no_default_synonym_merge: Same name across different entity type / config applicability / namespace yields distinct canonical ids; near-name similarity never merges. Group identity for pending cases keeps canonical_id=null.
what_was_implemented.multi_source_evidence_retained: All field observations, body variants, evidence proofs and contributors are retained per group; contradictory business values keep every value with provenance and never select a winner.
what_was_implemented.human_confirmed_values_protected: merge(..., human_confirmed={...}) records a separate authoritative overlay per group (human_confirmed / human_confirmed_fields) without deleting the model observations. Undeclared fields are rejected; identity-defining fields cannot be rewritten by a hand edit.
what_was_implemented.expected_revision_cas: merge(..., previous_receipt=..., expected_revision=...) and resolve_merge_revision() implement an expected_revision CAS gate: a writer holding a stale revision is refused with ConflictError (concurrent edit preserved), never overwriting the newer human-confirmed revision. report field human_revision_cas is now truthful ('revision_bound' / 'not_supplied').
what_was_implemented.unresolved_conflicts_excluded_from_valid: Each group carries in_valid_graph; payload exposes valid_graph and excluded_from_valid_graph. Conflict, pending_identity and other non-admitted states are retained as evidence but never admitted; receipt reports valid_graph_count/excluded_count/alias_collision_count. diagnostic_publishable stays false.

owned_files: tests/enterprise_kb/test_wiki_candidate_merge.py (30 passed, 1 assertion updated to the new truthful human_revision_cas value plus valid_graph/alias_ownership assertions)

tc_coverage.TC-10.7: same display name across type/config/namespace -> distinct canonical ids; alias collision reported, never merged
tc_coverage.TC-10.8: two-source conflict preserved; expected_revision detects concurrent edit; human-confirmed value never overwritten by model rerun
tc_coverage.TC-16.12: same name different type/level not merged; sources/conflicts complete; expected_revision rejects stale write; duplicate rebuild produces no duplicate entity; unresolved conflict excluded from valid graph

remaining_gaps: Semantic/ontology identity verification and trusted entity catalog remain pending (KB-026): canonical_id is a provisional business identity, not a trusted entity id.
Alias ownership is collision-aware but not verified against a durable alias registry; alias_ownership_verified stays false.

Human-edit CAS is a revision gate over the private merge receipt only; it is not yet wired to the Wiki HTTP/job entry points or to md-level expected_revision on published pages (KB-027/KB-028 cross-module work).
The valid graph here is the private merge projection (valid_graph/excluded_from_valid_graph); there is no published diagnostic graph, relation-closure gate, or derived-index rebuild in this task.
Merge remains a private draft_merge profile: diagnostic_publishable is false and no entity/edge/index is published.
cross_module_interface_needed: openviking/wiki/merge.py merge() now accepts keyword-only previous_receipt and human_confirmed; Wiki HTTP/job entry points (openviking/server/routers/wiki.py, openviking/service/wiki_job_service.py) must thread the current private merge receipt plus the client expected_revision to activate human-edit CAS end to end. Not editable under KB-025 ownership.

A durable alias/identity registry (KB-026 trusted entity catalog) is required to promote alias_ownership_verified and canonical_id from provisional to trusted; identity.py exposes alias_ownership()/identity_tuple() for that consumer.
